request_contract.parameter_rules: Exact published version and filename only. Historical data-file GET used download=1; code used exact API content path. Documentation-only; no new live request, scheduled fetch or bulk transfer authorized.

response_contract.format: Published gridded reported crop-damage information; original insurer reports are not automatically public and are not interchangeable with these research grids
response_contract.scientific_semantics: The NHESS Portmann et al. 2024 article explicitly identifies Zenodo 11064767 as 'Reported hail damage for 12 hail events in Switzerland' and says gridded damage information is available. This is a candidate for footprint occurrence validation, not permission to distribute underlying insurer claims, loss amounts or identifiable records. Review the precise Zenodo license, anonymization/aggregation, per-event units and linkage to hazard and exposure before download, rehosting or use. The same insured source data were used to design/assess the published method, so no independent holdout is implied. Confirm insurer-derived gridded observations are within depositor authority and intended commercial-use scope; review anonymization, spatial granularity and disclosure. 10-12 selected days by crop. Do not infer monetary severity or annual frequency. Historical original replay found 550 positive event-grid entries without matched exposure position across three 2 km pairs. Preserve outside-support counts; no naive positional join.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No new automated requests authorized. Review current Zenodo service terms, aggregate transfer budget, exact file and acquisition scope before any replay.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Version-specific record ID and publisher MD5; record exact observed size, SHA-256 and retrieval time separately for every asset. Do not replace original release with concept DOI or latest version.
